description: Deep hip muscles missing from the Rajagopal-derived legs. scripts/generate_deep_hip_muscles.py writes their sites, tendons and actuators into the leg XML from this table; tests/test_deep_hip_muscles.py checks them.

source.citation: Delp SL, Loan JP, Hoy MG, Zajac FE, Topp EL, Rosen JM. An interactive graphics-based model of the lower extremity to study orthopaedic surgical procedures. IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 37(8):757-767, 1990; OpenSim model Gait2392 (Seth, Anderson, Delp), CC BY 3.0, https://github.com/opensim-org/opensim-models

method: Femur points, peak force, optimal fibre length and tendon slack length are Gait2392's; femur frames coincide between the models. Pelvis points are mapped into the Rajagopal pelvis frame with a similarity transform fitted on 27 points of 21 muscles present in both models (leave-one-muscle-out error about 11 mm). The attachment points lie 2 to 10 mm from the nearest vertex of their bone mesh. Peak forces stay at Gait2392's values, smaller than the Rajagopal forces of the neighbouring muscles (piriformis 1030 N here, 444 N in Gait2392).

curve.note: the leg muscles' default curve with lmin and lmax of the piriformis

fit.method: range and lengthrange: MuJoCo's linear map fitted to the rigid-tendon fibre length (L - L_ts) / L_fo over the full hip range (myo_sim.build.rigid_conversion.fit_rigid_muscle_map; random postures plus each hip joint swept alone)

comparison_with_gait2392.protocol: OpenSim 4.6 on gait2392_thelen2003muscle.osim against this model on 45 hip postures (flexion -20, 0, 25, 50, 90; adduction -15, 0, 15; rotation -20, 0, 20 deg)
